On Tue, Jun 14, 2026 at 9:12 AM David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Chandra,
>
> Hope you and the team are doing well. Your current Dedicated reserved pool (8 GPUs) renewal is coming up...

Thanks for the quick reply. Below is the operational plan and answers to your questions. We attached a draft amendment for review (PDF stub).

Operational plan (targeted activation window: week of 2026-07-20):
- Week 0 (pre-sign): finalize amendment, procure PO, and schedule technical kickoff.
- Week 1 (canary): enable 4 additional GPUs onto a canary slice (10% of traffic) for 3 business days. Monitoring: latency p50/p95/p99, token throughput, error rate.
- Week 2 (ramp): expand to 8 additional GPUs (total 16), gradually shift traffic over 5 days, validate autoscaling behavior.
- Week 3 (stabilize): full production traffic, retention of prefix/KV cache warming, final runbook handed to your SREs.

Performance commitments we propose for the 16-GPU reserved pool:
- Latency SLO: p99 <= 200ms for requests up to 512 tokens (subject to workload distribution).
- Throughput: sustained batch-aware throughput with automatic batching; we will target no-regression vs current 8-GPU baseline and provide per-route throughput dashboards in Redwood Console.
- Uptime SLA: 99.9% monthly for Dedicated pools (standard in the amendment).

Billing / proration:
- New monthly commit begins on the first full billing cycle after amendment execution. For July (mid-month renewal), we can pro-rate the monthly commit for the partial month and align future invoices to calendar months (or bill on your existing cadence if you prefer).

Next steps I recommend:
1) Procurement: confirm PO + invoicing cadence and sign DocuSign amendment.
2) Schedule 60-min technical kickoff (we'll invite infra/ML infra and an accounts ops engineer).
3) Pre-activation checklist: CIDR/IP allowlist, KMS/HSM key verification (if using Private), and model variant pinning for safe fallbacks.

[attachment: renewal_amendment_draft.pdf]

Happy to hop on a call tomorrow to walk through the amendment.

—
